title: A worker sets changes aside in its scratch directory, never in the shared git stash
goal: The kb-worker role file tells a worker to set aside a change outside its touches as a patch in its scratch directory, never with git stash, whose stack every worktree shares (ST-t67jhly3 left two stash entries, st-t67jhly3-snapshot and st-t67jhly3-decisions-sweep, in the clone's shared stack).
notes: SP-up5wchen (2026-10-11): the research worker of ST-4ehra2pk again took its suite baseline with its changes stashed in the shared git stash; it left no entry behind.
